triggers.notes: Available from the Lessons catalog and from explicit Learn more actions on proficiency badges or the proficiency picker.
Universal metalinguistic lesson. It explains Gef proficiency labels rather than teaching a grammar construction in one target language.

presentation.scroll_mode: render groups in one article-like vertical lesson surface
presentation.pages_mode: render each explanation as one or more readable pages without changing the source lesson content
presentation.teacher_presentation_mode: use the same source blocks with classroom-sized controls; do not fork the lesson

badge_deep_link_policy.entry: open the lesson at the tapped level block

presentation.manual_picker_policy: The quick self-report picker uses center 0 plus seven outward stops: A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2, and Gef-only Fully fluent / Native. Pre-A1 remains an internal first-steps band between zero and A1 rather than a visible manual ring.
presentation.content_difficulty_policy: A level badge on a book describes reading demand unless another scope is explicitly stored.
presentation.learner_level_policy: Learner proficiency may retain separate Reading, Listening, Speaking, Writing, Interaction, and Mediation values. Current Gef product evidence may update Reading only; the other axes remain self-report-only until a real feature measures them.
